title: Continuous tangential lift of DF along a C¹ immersion, with norm bound (∇^N F; parent Step 9)
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (F : Euclid m → ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ Φ : Euclid m → Euclid P, ContinuousOn Φ V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, Φ y ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ (∀ e : Euclid m, inner ℝ (Φ y) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) ∧ ∀ L : NNReal, (∀ e : Euclid m, |fderiv ℝ F y e| ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y e‖) → ‖Φ y‖ ≤ (L : ℝ)
